title: Provider Refund and Billing Dispute Terms, by PracticePay Plan
content:
Provider refunds and billing disputes are handled on the same terms across PracticePay Patient Financing, except for whether the monthly payment is recalculated after a partial provider refund.

## Recalculation after a partial provider refund

| Plan | Monthly payment recalculated after a partial provider refund |
|---|---|
| PracticePay 6-Month Deferred Interest Plan | no; the term shortens |
| PracticePay 6-Month No Interest Plan | yes; the remaining balance is re-divided equally over the remaining payments |
| PracticePay 12-Month Deferred Interest Plan | no; the term shortens |
| PracticePay 12-Month No Interest Plan | yes; the remaining balance is re-divided equally over the remaining payments |
| PracticePay 24-Month Reduced APR Plan | no; the term shortens |
| PracticePay 48-Month Reduced APR Plan | no; the term shortens |
| PracticePay 60-Month Extended Plan | no; the term shortens |

## Terms common to every plan

- **How a provider refund is applied:** reduces the plan balance on the refund date; it is not a payment and does not satisfy or advance a monthly payment due.
- **Refund posting:** a provider refund posts to the plan within 3 business days after the provider submits it.
- **Full provider refund:** plan cancelled; interest and fees still owed on the plan are waived, the deferred interest memo is cleared, and payments already made are refunded to the patient.
- **Credit balance:** refunded to the patient within 10 business days after it arises.
- **Billing dispute window:** a patient can open a billing dispute on the treatment charge within 60 calendar days after the purchase date.
- **Late-fee protection during a dispute:** the disputed amount is left out of the amount past due for late fees while the dispute is open (on every plan).

## Points of reading

- After a partial provider refund on a no-interest plan the remaining balance is re-divided equally over the remaining payments, so the monthly payment falls; on the other plans the monthly payment stays the same and the plan simply ends sooner.
